items.title: Carmen Leggio interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: But Les Davis used to play down, as a theme song, “Hallelujah Time.”

ctx.x: Sal Nestico was an amazing saxophonist.

Yeah, that’s right. Died young. Good person. He wasted himself, that’s all. But him and I we were soulful that day. And Les Davis used to play down, as a theme song, “Hallelujah Time.” But that was a good album. © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-
Who were some of your favorite arrangers through the different bands, that you’d like to see their charts coming.
